error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a ShadeAuto hub at that address.

init.title: ShadeAuto options
init.description: Tuning for polling, pacing and verification. Changes apply immediately. To change the hub's IP address or hostname, use Reconfigure from the entry's menu instead.

data.motion_poll_sec: Poll interval while a shade is moving (seconds)
data.push_enabled: Use the hub's change notifications (push updates)
data.collision_guard: Two-rail shades: keep the top rail at or above the bottom rail
data.rail_min_gap: Two-rail shades: minimum gap between the rails (%)
data.verify_enabled: Verify the shade arrived and retry once if not
data.estimation_enabled: Animate the position slider while a shade is moving (the hub's position always wins)
data.full_travel_time_sec: Time for a full open or close (seconds)

data_description.push_enabled: Reads a shade as soon as the hub announces that it changed, instead of at the next poll. Polling continues either way.
data_description.tilt_mode: Automatic exposes tilt on shades with vanes (PerfectSheer) only. Off hides it everywhere; the vanes keep their setting either way.
data_description.collision_guard: When a move would cross the rails, the other rail moves out of the way. Applies to top-down/bottom-up and day/night shades only.
data_description.send_spacing_sec: The hub drops commands sent too close together while still reporting success.
